name: Home Assistant, Entities
description: A status grid of several Home Assistant entities. Each row tints by its state (on / off / other), leads with a device-class-aware Phosphor glyph (temperature → thermometer, CO₂ → wind, motion → person walking, …), and shows its current value. Rows that changed within the last 10 minutes pick up an accent-4 wash + a 'just now' / 'Nm ago' badge.

cell_options.name: overrides
cell_options.label: Names, icons and formats
cell_options.help: One row per ticked entity. Leave the name blank to keep the auto label; pick "No icon" to keep the auto icon. The format box overrides the widget number format for that entity (blank = use the widget default).

cell_options.name: show_last_updated
cell_options.label: Last updated
cell_options.help: Off hides the 'just now' / 'Nm ago' badge on recently changed rows and the changed count in the title row. On shows both for rows that changed within the last 10 minutes.

cell_options.name: show_title
cell_options.label: Title line
cell_options.help: Off hides the whole title row (icon + title + count).

cell_options.name: show_names
cell_options.label: Names
cell_options.help: Off hides the per-row entity name, leaving icon + value.

cell_options.name: number_format
cell_options.label: Number format
cell_options.help: How numeric values are shown. Blank rounds to 2 decimals and trims trailing zeros (21.00 → 21). Use 0 for whole numbers, 0.0 for one decimal, 0.00 for two, and so on. Per-entity formats live in Names, icons and formats.
